scenes.text: Someone keeps switching off your beacon. Tonight, you catch them.
You're shipwrecked, alone, on a tiny island. Every time you turn the beacon on, it's off by morning.
So you build a trap. First, a net, woven from palm fibers.
You hang it in the palm above the beacon, held by one thin line.
A tripwire in the sand. Touch it, and the net drops.
And shells on a string, so you'll hear it from your shelter.
Then the bait. You switch the beacon on.
Around two in the morning, somewhere in the dark, someone is humming.
You grab the knife, and run.
The net is down. The beacon is off. But nobody's in it.
Instead, under the net, a cooked fish, wrapped in a leaf.
And scratched into the sand, one word.
Whoever they are, they won't hurt you. But they really don't want that beacon on. What do you do? Top comment decides part three.
